items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Joe Rose, you, you met Joe Rose.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mm-hmm. And then, when he brought that, uh, that, that long-necked band in there, oh, he had two feet, remember, the boy line there was, you know, Mm-hmm. I saw that he was, uh, making of a outstanding bandit player, they let him, you know, use him, you know, demonstrate. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Man, what you got there, man? I don't know, but I'm gonna try it out tonight. I say, but you got the other guitar? Oh, yeah, I got it. All done tonight, man, he picked that thing up, man. He picked a lead on that man's…
